query:
After the group discussed how cloud cancellations had reshaped a member's site choice, who said something to the effect that good-enough conditions every night beat perfect conditions a few times a year?

Options:
A. Bex
B. Camila
C. Henrik
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Camila, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T20:15:00) ymmv but the desert teaches you that good-enough conditions every night beats perfect conditions twice a year
[2] (about=Camila, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T20:14:00) honestly Bex this resonates with me. every clear-sky chase I've made cost more than it gave back
[3] (about=Ravi, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T20:09:00) Frankly: the obsession with bortle 1 has always been performative for most members of this hobby. Bortle 3 with a clear sky beats Bortle 1 under cirrus every time.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T20:07:00) the math always favored closer dark sites anyway. the Bortle 1 vs 3 SNR delta is small once you control for travel-stress and setup quality.
[5] (about=Henrik, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T20:20:00) There's a signal-to-noise argument here as well. Per unit clear sky time, a regular Bortle 3 with 50 sessions a year integrates more useful photons than a Bortle 1 you reach four times per year. The math favors consistency.
[6] (about=Bex, said_by=Theo, profile, t4 @2025-03-17T20:03:00) Theo says Bex's adjustment to closer dark sites is sensible after two clouded weekends.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Camila, group-insight, t4 @2025-03-17T20:03:00) Group norm: good-enough conditions every night beats perfect conditions twice a year.
[8] (about=Diego, episodic, t16 @2025-04-28T10:12:00) btw seeing was the real win. lunar mosaic from saturday looks better than anything I've shot from home in years. doesn't matter how dark when the seeing is bad imo.
[9] (about=Felix, episodic, t8 @2025-03-31T19:45:00) the nina learning curve is real. ines: pace yourself, don't try to tackle scripting until you have a plain sequence working three nights in a row.
[10] (about=Marcus, core, t2 @2025-03-10T18:51:00) Had two clear nights over the weekend, 11 hours on M81 across both.
[11] (about=Mei, core, t18 @2025-05-05T20:12:00) Summer night shifts hit different; wishing everyone clear skies.
[12] (about=Ravi, core, t16 @2025-04-28T10:02:00) Notes trip-goers had a good time; backyard sessions do not produce post-trip exhaustion; point taken on social value.
[13] (about=Theo, episodic, t4 @2025-03-17T20:05:00) Bex, that's a really sensible adjustment. Two clouded weekends in a row is enough data to update on, in my experience.
[14] (about=Tomas, episodic, t10 @2025-04-07T11:32:00) Marcus, that opens up daytime sessions. You'll never have a clouded-out morning the way you do at night. Frankly this is going to consume your weekends.
